chip.draft: Draft · saved when you create it
chip.editing: Editing · saved when you save changes

confirm.title: Create the questionnaire?
confirm.body: Nothing has been saved yet. Once you confirm, the questionnaire is created in your account.

details.title: Details
details.subtitle: Set up the basics. On the right you see live what your customer will see.
details.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only. Leave empty to generate it from the title.
details.landingHint: Enable a welcome page using your questionnaire's title and description.
details.disclaimerHint: Show respondents a disclaimer they must accept before starting the questionnaire.
details.descriptionPlaceholder: Briefly describe what this questionnaire is about
details.disclaimerPlaceholder: Enter the disclaimer respondents must accept to continue
details.disclaimerRequired: Write the disclaimer text to continue.
details.movedNote: Capture user data and Call to action are in the last step, next to what is shown at the end.
details.tagsHint: Labels to find it again, e.g. AP-03. Press Enter or a comma to add one (up to {{max}}).
details.tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter

tagsErrors.tooMany: A questionnaire has at most {{max}} tags.
tagsErrors.tooLong: A tag has at most {{max}} characters.

questions.title: Questions
questions.subtitle: Add and order the questions of your questionnaire.
questions.question: Question {{n}}
questions.categoryHint: Pick one or type a new category.
questions.requiredLocked: Scored questions feed the calculation, so they're always required.
questions.followupsHint: When the AI finds the answer unclear, it asks again up to this many times (0–5).
questions.criteriaHint: Define up to 10 criteria the answer must meet. Only applies to open questions with follow-ups.
questions.fixedRowsHint: The respondent fills in each of these rows.
questions.freeRowsHint: The respondent adds the rows they need (up to {{max}}).
questions.templateHint: A file the respondent downloads, fills in and uploads back (up to 20 MB).
questions.templateTooLarge: The template is larger than 20 MB. Please choose a smaller file.
questions.requiredHint: When off, respondents can skip this question without answering.
questions.diagnosticSubtitle: Put every question in a category. Scored answers add up to the total and to each area.
questions.hasProblem: This question has something to complete
questions.cannotRemove: A questionnaire must have at least one question.

end.title: When it ends
end.subtitle: Choose what respondents see when they finish.
end.ctaHint: A button that takes respondents somewhere next.
end.captureHint: Asks for name, email and phone at the end.
end.empty: The final page is empty. Add elements from the list on the left.
end.poolHelp: Add what your customer will see at the end.

thank_you.name: Thank-you message
thank_you.description: Title and message at the end

cta.name: Call to action
cta.description: A button with a link at the end

cta.title: Title
cta.urlHint: Use the exact destination link, including https://.
cta.newTab: The call to action always opens in a new tab, so the user doesn't lose their results.

results.title: Results
results.subtitle: Respondents are placed in a tier by their total score.
results.copyHint: Optional, up to 300 characters each. Leave empty to use the default text.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.subtitle: Each prompt uses the answers so far to generate the next questionnaire.
prompts.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Ask three follow-up questions about the goal they chose.
prompts.generatedBody: Generated from the answers and prompt {{n}}

success.body: Share it with your customers or assign it to an organization.

locked.title: Locked to preserve answers
locked.body: This questionnaire already has answers, so it can't be edited. Create a copy to change it.
locked.confirmBody: A new questionnaire is created in your account, with no answers, ready to edit.

generic.title: Edit questionnaire
generic.subtitle: This type is edited in one page.

errors.title: Write a title to continue.
errors.slug: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
errors.slugInUse: That custom link (slug) is already in use by another questionnaire. Choose a different one.
errors.disclaimer: Write the disclaimer text to continue.
errors.noQuestions: Add at least one question to continue.
errors.noOptions: Question {{n}} needs at least one answer choice.
errors.optionLabel: All answer choices in question "{{title}}" must have a label.
errors.optionScore: All answer choices in question "{{title}}" must have a numeric score.
errors.uniqueScore: All answer choices in question "{{title}}" must have a unique score value.
errors.range: Question "{{title}}" range input: both min and max are required and min must be lower than max.
errors.criteria: Question {{n}} needs at least one acceptance criterion for its follow-ups.
errors.charsets: Question {{n}} must allow at least one kind of character.
errors.diagnosticType: Question {{n}} uses an input type a diagnostic does not allow.
errors.category: Every question needs a category — your tiers are built from these categories.
errors.noScorable: Add at least one scored question (selection with score, ranking or range) so your respondents can be placed in a tier.
errors.thankYouTooLong: The thank-you title and message can have at most 300 characters.
errors.ctaTitleRequired: The call to action title is required.
errors.ctaTitleTooLong: The call to action title is too long.
errors.ctaDescriptionTooLong: The call to action description is too long.
errors.ctaButtonTooLong: The button text is too long.
errors.ctaUrl: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.
errors.tierRange: Fill in the score range (from and to) for every tier.
errors.tierOrder: A tier's "from" score can't be greater than its "to" score.
errors.tierStart: Your first tier must start at 0.
errors.tierEnd: Your tiers must reach the top score of {{max}}.
errors.tierGap: Tiers can't leave gaps or overlap — each one must start right after the previous.
errors.copyTooLong: Each text of the results page can have at most 300 characters.
errors.tooManyPrompts: A chain can have at most {{max}} prompts.
errors.upload: We couldn't upload the prompts. Please try again.
errors.noColumns: Question {{n}} needs at least one column.
errors.columnLabel: All columns in question "{{title}}" must have a name.
errors.uniqueColumns: The columns in question "{{title}}" must have different names.

stepSubtitles.regular: Build what your customer sees when they finish the questionnaire.
stepSubtitles.diagnostic: Define your levels and build the result page with the elements you want to show.
stepSubtitles.chaining: Each prompt uses the answers so far to generate the next questionnaire.

shopper.disclaimerPlaceholder: The disclaimer text will show here.
shopper.rankingHint: Drag the options to order them by preference
shopper.followupHint: If your answer is short, we'll ask you to expand on it.
shopper.message: Information screen: asks for no answer.
shopper.contactTitle: Where should we send your results?
shopper.contactDescription: Share your contact details so we can deliver your personalized recommendations.
shopper.contactPrivacy: Your information is private and will only be used to deliver your results.
shopper.defaultEndTitle: Your answers have been sent successfully.
shopper.defaultEndMessage: Thank you for completing the questionnaire. We saved your answers and the team can now review them.
